# Chassis examples

BetaCrawler is electronics, not a chassis — this page collects printable and buildable models that
can house them. These are starting points, not a definitive list.

Check a model's own page for scale, motor mounts and battery space before committing to it; fit
against your specific motors, drivers and battery is on you to verify.

## Skid steer

Anything with two independently driven sides and room to mount a board, motor drivers and a
battery.

### RC Tank — Staind

A printable tracked chassis with brushless motor brackets, gearboxes and a universal ESC holder —
a good match for the [brushless skid build](skid/brushless.md). Released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

**[thingiverse.com/thing:2414983](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:2414983)**

## Car

Anything with a steered front axle and a driven rear, with room for the same electronics.

A donor RC car is usually the cheapest route: the chassis, steering servo and motor are already
there, and only the electronics change. A car that already has a brushed motor drops straight into
the [brushed car build](car/brushed.md).
